title: Ecosystem & Growth
goals: Onboard three production integrations using the managed API
Ship mobile consumer wallet MVP (iOS + Android)
Expand EVM support to Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Polygon
Launch .wraith human-readable name service on mainnet
highlights: Three production integrations live — payroll, DEX, NFT marketplace
Mobile wallet TestFlight beta open to 500 users
Ethereum, Base, and Polygon mainnet contracts deployed
.wraith name registrations open on Horizen EON
summary: Wave 6 closed 2024 with the protocol in the hands of real users. Production integrations shipped, the mobile wallet entered beta, EVM coverage expanded to Ethereum mainnet and L2s, and the .wraith name service made stealth addresses human-readable for the first time.
winnersNote: Drips stream closed 2025-01-05. Mobile wallet contributors received additional equity-equivalent grant.
